name: Delphi
insight: Raised a $16M Series A in June 2025 led by Sequoia, with participation from Anthropic's Anthology Fund.
tagline: Turn your expertise into a 'digital mind' that answers in your voice 24/7.
description: Delphi lets experts, creators and coaches clone their knowledge into a conversational 'digital mind' trained on their writing, talks and frameworks, which then answers their audience's questions in their voice around the clock. It supports text and voice interaction, multilingual replies and audience analytics. The San Francisco company calls the personas 'digital minds' rather than clones.
edge: Purpose-built to clone one expert's full body of work into an on-brand, voice-matched assistant — not a generic character chatbot.
pros: Clones a real expert's voice and frameworks
